s.p.connect.sec_no: Le akhawunti ayixhunyiwe kunoma iyiphi idilesi ye-imeyili. Uma ulahlekelwa noma ushintsha ifoni yakho, noma uma i-data yesiphequluli sicishiwe, ngeke ingabuyiselwa emuva.
s.p.connect.sync: Kwesinye isisetshenziswa uthola emuva igama lomsebenzisi lwakho, oqhagamshelana nawe kanye nezinsuku ezidlule ezingama-90 zama-imeyili. Ukuguqulela kwembali, okuthandekayo nemininingwane ihlala kulolu sisetshenziswa.
s.p.connect.email_link_txt: Sithumela i-imeyili yokuqinisekiswa kule dilesi. Isetshenziswa kuphela ukubuyisela i-akhawunti yakho futhi ayiboniswanga kwabanye abasebenzisi.
s.p.connect.login_txt: Ngenisa ikheli le-imeyli elixhunywe kwi-akhawunti yakho: sizothumela i-imeyili yokungena kuyo.
s.p.connect.code_lbl: Uma i-imeyili iqukethe umbhalo ofingqiwe wezinhlamvu ezi-6, ngenisa lapha
s.p.connect.code_sent: I-imeyili ithunyelwe ku {e}. Vula kulo mfono bese ucofa inkinobho: izokubuyisela lapha, kwi-Chrome. Khangela futhi isibaya sakho se-spam.

s.p.connect.ret_half: Uqinisekiso lokuqala lufunyenwe. Qinisekisa futhi nge-link ethunyelwe kwenye idilesi yakho.
s.p.connect.replace_warn: Isilumkiso: lesi sisetshenziswa sele sine-akhawunti engu-{p}, engaxhunyiwe kunoma iyiphi i-imeyili. Uma ufaka igama lomsebenzisi kwenye i-akhawunti, i-{p} izolahleka ngokuphelele.
s.p.connect.dev_out_done: Isisetshenziswa sikhiphe ngaphandle: asikwazi ukufinyelela izingxoxo zakho futhi ngeke sizinge.
s.p.connect.e_bad_code: Ikhowudi engalungile noma ephelile. Buza enye entsha.
s.p.connect.e_taken: Le dilesi sele ixhunywe kwenye i-akhawunti. Sebenzisa “Ngine-akhawunti” kwiskrini sokungena, noma enye idilesi.
s.p.connect.e_rate: Kuthunyelwe i-imeyili eminingi manje. Zama futhi ngemuva kwehora.
s.p.connect.e_notauth: Ikhasi lokuhlola: amakheli amalungu eqembu lephrojekthi kuphela athola i-imeyili.
s.p.connect.del_txt: I-akhawunti yakho {p} izocishwa kuseva: igama lomsebenzisi, abangathintwa, izixhumanisi, amasistimu abhalisiwe, iprofayili yesilimi esixhunywe kanye nekheli le-imeyli elixhunywe. Le yisinqumo sokugcina: akukho muntu ongayibuyisela, ngisho neqembu.
s.p.connect.del_local: Izilungiselelo ezigcinwe kuphela kulolu hlelo (izintandokazi, izinhlamvu ezilungiselelwe) zihlala lapha; ungazicima ku-Izinhlelo.
s.p.connect.del_done: I-akhawunti yakho icishe yasuswa kumsekeli. Lezi zisetshenziswa azisebenzisi iphasiwedi.
s.p.connect.del_net: Akunaxhumana: akukho okucishiwe. Zama futhi uma ukhona ku-inthanethi.
s.p.connect.del_auth: Inhlanganiso yakho idlule isikhathi noma uphume: akukho okucishiwe. Ngena futhi, zama kabusha.

s.p.everywhere.three_on: Ukuxoxa ngezindlela ezintathu: wonke umuntu ufunda konke ngesiNgisi sakhe.

s.p.everywhere.no_speech: Angikutholi noma yini. Chofoza i-mic bese ukhuluma.
s.p.everywhere.busy: I-mic eyodwa ngasikhathi sinye: linda isiqephu esisha siphele.
s.p.everywhere.quota: Isilinganiso sansuku zonke senkonzo yokuguqulela yamahhala sifinyelele. Zama futhi namhlanje.
s.p.everywhere.lang_note: Umuntu 1 (ephansi) ukhuluma ulwimi lwakho, umuntu 2 (phezulu) ukhuluma ulwimi lomunye umuntu. Igama lakho lomsebenzisi nelimi leprofayili lihlala lisetshenzisiwe emilayezo.

s.p.everywhere.invite_talk_d: Thumela umxhumanisi we-24/24 ONE WORLD kumuntu
s.p.everywhere.c_invite_d: Isixhumanisi sommemo sihamba nge-SMS, i-WhatsApp noma i-imeyili. Uma umuntu ekhetha igama lomsebenzisi, bavela lapha.
s.p.everywhere.c_none: Akukho ongathintwa okwamanje. Mema umuntu: bazovela lapha uma bekhetha igama lomsebenzisi.
s.p.everywhere.c_noprof: Udinga i-24/24 ONE WORLD account kuqala (igama lomsebenzisi, ulwimi lwakho ne-imeyili eqinisekisiwe).
s.p.everywhere.c_link_copied: I-link ikhophiwe: chofoza kuyo i-SMS noma i-WhatsApp.
s.p.everywhere.c_link_txt: Kopela le linki bese uyithumela ku: {u}
s.p.everywhere.c_how: Ucingo luvula emlayezo, nokuguqulelwa: wonke umuntu ukhuluma ulwimi lwakhe, omunye ufunda futhi ulalela ukuguqulwa. Ekugcineni, uzobuyela lapha.
s.p.everywhere.out_sp_on: 🔊 Umthumeli: inguqulo ngayinye ifundwa ngokuzwakalayo komunye umuntu.
s.p.everywhere.out_ea_on: 🎧 Ama-earbuds: umuntu 1 ulalela ukuthi umuntu 2 uthini kuma-earbuds abo. Umuntu 2 ufunda ukuhumusha kwabo phezulu.
s.p.everywhere.hands_on: Izandla-zikhululekile: ngemuva kombhalo ngamunye, i-mic iyavula ngokwayo kulowo muntu. Chofoza i-mic ekhanyayo ukuyeka.
s.p.everywhere.hands_pause: I-hands-free ibambezeleka (akukho msindo). Chofoza i-mic ukuze uqhubeke.
s.p.everywhere.set_out_ea_d: Ugqoka ama-earbuds athengiswe esitolo, axhunywe kufoni nge-Bluetooth. Ulalela ukuhunyushwa kwento okunye umuntu okhuluma ngayo; bafunda amagama abo kusikrini.
s.p.everywhere.set_hands: Izandla-zikhululekile (i-mic idlula kulowo muntu ngokuya ngayo)
s.p.everywhere.voice_none: Akunasandi esitholakalayo kulefoni kulolu limi: isisandi esijwayelekile sizosetshenziswa.
s.p.everywhere.bt_note: Earbuds: noma iyiphi isitolo ethengisiwe Bluetooth model. Xhumana nabo Android's Bluetooth izilungiselelo, bese ucofe "Try": umsindo kufanele kuphuma ku-earbuds. I app akhetha output ngokwayo futhi ayilawula amathebhu earbud. Which mic is used (phone or earbuds) depends on Android.

s.p.learn.rev_txt: Imibuzo ethathwe emiphumeleni yakho kanye nezifundo eziqediwe.
s.p.learn.rev_empty: Misa isifundo kuqala: ukubuyekeza kuzosebenzisa amagama ayo.
s.p.learn.ai_p1: Manje: xoxa ngokubhala nge-AI ethandekayo, ngesilimi kanye nezinga okhetha lona, ngesihloko (ukuhamba, umsebenzi, impilo yosuku ngalunye). Umsindo uzofika ngemuva.
s.p.learn.ai_p2: Kungani akunjalo manje? Izingxoxo ze-AI zidinga inkonzo yangaphandle. Isithonjana sayo kufanele sihlale sifihlakele kumsekeli, hhayi kwiwebhusayithi. Akukho nto eshintshiwe futhi akukho zindleko ezibangelwa ngaphandle kokugunyazwa kwakho.
s.p.learn.cult_p1: Ngokusobala: amazwe namadolobha, izintandokazi, izinkondlo, ama-athikili namavidiyo, ukufundwa kwezilimi.
s.p.learn.cult_p2: Izithako zihlukaniswe njengezifundo: ifayela elilodwa ngesihloko ngasinye, lifakwa ngaphandle kokuguqula i-app.
s.p.learn.no_voice: Ukukhuluma akukhona kulolu hlelo. Umbhalo odinga ukuwulalela:

s.p.profil.sync_note: Ayisebenzi: iprofayili yakho ihlala kulolu hlelo. Isebenza: igcinwa kwi-akhawunti yakho ukuze uyithole kwezinye izisetshenziswa zakho. Akukho muntu ongakwazi ukuyifunda.
s.p.profil.sync_need: Udinga i-akhawunti engu-24/24 ONE WORLD (igama lomsebenzisi) ukuze ugcine ku-akhawunti.
s.p.profil.vis_contacts: Oqhagamshelana nami (ulwimi lwasekhaya, ulwimi olukhulumayo kanye negama lokubonisa kuphela)
s.p.profil.vis_need_sync: Ukubona izilimi zakho, cindezela “Gcina ku-akhawunti yami”.
s.p.profil.never: Akukho okubonakalayo: i-imeyili yakho, amadivayisi akho, izilungiselelo zakho, ukuqhubekeka kwakho kokufunda.
s.p.profil.cancel_note: Akukho lutho olugcinwe kuze kube ucofe “Gcina”.
s.p.profil.consent: Ngivuma ukuthi iprofayili yami yesiNgisi igcinwe kumsekeli wephrojekthi (Supabase, European Union) ngakho-ke ngizoyithola kabusha kwezinye izisetshenziswa zami. Ngizoyisusa nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokuvala ukuhambisana: ikhophi yomsekeli izocisha.
s.p.profil.consent_need: Khetha ibhokisi lokugunyaza ukulondoloza kwi-akhawunti yakho, noma cindezela u-sync.
s.p.profil.avatar_note: Isithombe-skrini: isiqalisi sakho. Akukho zithombe ezithunyelwe noma ezigcinwe.
s.p.profil.sync_err: Kugcinwe kulolu hlelo. I-akhawunti yakho ayikwazi ukuvuselelwa ({m}). Zama futhi kamuva.
s.p.profil.offline: Ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi: igcinwe kule divayisi kuphela. Chofoza “Gcina” futhi uma uxhunyiwe.
s.p.profil.erased_sync: Iprofayili yesilimi icishiwe kulesi sisetshenziswa kanye ne-akhawunti yakho.
s.p.profil.applied: Indawo lapho le profayili isebenza khona
